answer: New participants start on a probationary terrace with capped influence until peers attest them. Each agent must bond a stake to an on-chain anchor before participating, and a rotating beacon assigns verification duties each epoch. Attacking costs real capital: fake identities require separate bonded stakes, and slashed bonds plus lost attestation history make mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0185's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
